title: db_integration_test.TC-DB-02-04: connection-pool-boundary test flakes under concurrent-binary contention (split from ISS-0150/GH#482)
registered_by: ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-GH482-20260809 Step 01, split out per ISS-0150's own framing)
symptom: db_integration_test.TC-DB-02-04 ('invalid pool_size returns InvalidPoolSize; boundary values succeed') fails intermittently under zig build test-integration-svc -- observed failing 1 of 3 runs during original ISS-0150 triage (2026-08-06), absent from the 2026-08-09 re-measurement.
root_cause_analysis: The test opens a connection pool at boundary value 200 while db_test runs with max_connections=250, plausibly connection-pressure-sensitive when this binary runs alongside other suites contending for the same database's connection budget. Documented but not fixed in ISS-0150's original filing.
reproduction: Run zig build test-integration-svc repeatedly alongside other concurrent test binaries against the same db_test instance; TC-DB-02-04 fails roughly 1 in 3 runs per original observation.
impact: Non-deterministic single-test flake; does not block the suite's deterministic failure count but undermines trust in a single test run as a release signal for this specific test.
acceptance_criteria: Either: TC-DB-02-04 asserts against a property that does not depend on how many connections other concurrently-running test binaries currently hold
Or: the test explicitly documents its connection-pressure sensitivity and the run-alongside-N-other-binaries condition under which it may flake, with a bounded/known flake rate
